def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    X = inputs['initial_value']
    steps = inputs['steps']
    
    # Mask to keep within 32 bits
    MASK_32 = 0xFFFFFFFF
    
    for _ in range(steps):
        X = X ^ ((X << 13) & MASK_32)
        X = X ^ ((X >> 9) & MASK_32)
        X = X ^ ((X << 17) & MASK_32)
        X = X & MASK_32
    
    return float(X)
